caption:
Who answers you when you are desperate?

Allah responds to the distressed when they call on Him, and He relieves suffering. Whatever is weighing on you tonight, say it to Him in dua.

Surah An-Naml 27:62

Which worry will you hand over to Allah tonight?

#duainhardship #distress #surahnaml #quranreels

Recitation: Abdul Basit Abdus-Samad
alt_text: Is He [not better] Who responds to the distressed when he calls out to Him, and Who relieves suffering, and Who makes you successors on earth? Is there any god besides Allah? Little is it that you take heed (Surah An-Naml 27:62)
theme: dua in distress / Allah answers the desperate
